boundaries.rationale: LLM meaning decisions and deterministic local helpers are separated; no provider-specific branch was added.

flow.unknown_reason: Agent-managed checkpoint and publication flow is documented but not executed in Grok.

fit.unknown_reason: Fit for continuous operation depends on unavailable host tools and persistence.

contracts.rationale: Declared core contracts exercised through CLI, with explicit legacy mode and audit/output separation; not a full-schema or semantic validator.

edge_cases.rationale: Malformed refs, nested inputs, candidate collisions, Unicode, nonfinite values and corruption tested.
edge_cases.countercheck: Existing valid/legacy paths and failure-preserving checks also pass; actual archive totals remain unchanged. No semantic or live-model guarantee.

concurrency.rationale: Single-writer contract; fault before publishing entry retains previous complete state. Multiwriter and power-loss durability excluded explicitly.

access.unknown_reason: Host permissions and execution boundaries unavailable; helper containment alone does not establish agent authorization.

input_secrets.rationale: No network/subprocess in helper; untrusted paths contained, no secret configuration; prompt input boundary explicit. Host permissions untested.

abuse.unknown_reason: Host-enforced cumulative budgets, rate limits and storage caps not tested.

failure.rationale: CLI distinguishes input failure, missing evidence, cache miss and stale. Failed publication preserves previous readable entry.

recovery.unknown_reason: Local cache failure tested; full candidate ledger/session restart untested.

resilience.unknown_reason: External search outages, throttling and disk saturation not exercised in host.

clarity.rationale: Source-to-command-to-report paths traced and documented; implemented vs host responsibilities explicit.

change.rationale: Changes stay in grokbot and have regression cases plus unchanged real-data counts.

debt.rationale: Standalone standard-library helpers; common row contract reused by validation and grouping, no new framework.

duplication.rationale: Shared disposition and candidate identity prevents validator/coverage drift on important states.

reuse.rationale: Uses standard JSON/hash/path/atomic file operations; external search is left to existing agent tools, not duplicated.

abstraction.rationale: Small deterministic functions represent IO and accounting concepts; no scenario-specific classifier or provider factory.

risk_coverage.unknown_reason: Live model extraction, prompt injection and holdout workflow require behavioral execution.

quality.rationale: Meaningful negative tests cover reproduced failures and atomic publication fault, rather than checking prompt wording.
quality.countercheck: Existing valid/legacy paths and failure-preserving checks also pass; actual archive totals remain unchanged. No semantic or live-model guarantee.

automation.rationale: Documented repeatable unittest and Skill validation commands; tests isolate files with cleanup. Live agent evaluation remains separate.

dependencies.unknown_reason: No third-party Python packages; Python runtime maintenance/update process not assessed.

build_release.unknown_reason: Local folder verified, but real transfer/install/update in Grok untested.

license.unknown_reason: Original-source rights metadata explicitly unverified; no broad distribution-rights audit.

budget.unknown_reason: No representative long-running host cost/latency/storage measurements.

hot_path.unknown_reason: Historical small archive tested; large source snapshots and growth not benchmarked.

measurement.unknown_reason: Unit timings are not representative operational performance evidence.

signals.rationale: Structured errors, explicit legacy profile, first_output count/validation and cache states are observable; no claim of live job status.

lifecycle.unknown_reason: Native installation, update and restart in Grok not executed.

interaction.unknown_reason: Target user/agent end-to-end workflow not observed; local CLI exercised only.
